summary: Lesson 14, two refinements after review. (1) Chart point flash on bracket-card tap is now bigger (max radius 26 vs 18), brighter (solid orange #ea580c vs amber #f59e0b), thicker (stroke-width starts at 4 vs 2.5), and lasts longer (3 cycles at 0.85s vs 2 cycles at 0.65s, total ~2.55s vs ~1.3s). The JS timeout that removes the ring from the DOM was extended to match, so the longer animation isn't cut short. (2) Narrowed an overstated population claim in the BP flag comments: the water-pressor rise evidence is specific to autonomic-dysfunction and older patients, not "cardiac patients" broadly. Not every cardiac patient has autonomic involvement, and this app's users are a wider group than the studied population. No behavior change from this fix, comment-only, but it matters for the article's accuracy.
